protocol.allocation: Correct mapped annotation disagreements, then review a uniform consensus sample to exhaust the fixed total budget. If disagreements exceed the total budget, use a uniform audit of the whole pool instead.
protocol.scope: Real recorded human annotations and cached image classifiers. Corrections use dataset reference labels to emulate adjudication. Binary labels are a fixed coarsening of the original task, not new human annotations. All grid configurations are reported; no test-selected guarantee or new independent classifier training is claimed.
